close_reason: Fixed: removed false 'default implementation' claim from trait doc comment; method is abstract, each backend must implement; corrected to state persistent backends must use a transaction
description: group_log/storage.rs provides a default impl of insert_entry_and_advance_tips that calls insert_entry and then advance_tips as two separate operations. A crash between the two leaves the entry stored but the tips not updated (or vice versa). For the in-memory backend this is acceptable (no persistence), but any backend that overrides only some trait methods and inherits this default will have a crash window. The trait should either remove the default impl (forcing each backend to implement it) or document clearly that the default is only safe for non-persistent backends.
title: core: LogStorage default impl of insert_entry_and_advance_tips is not crash-safe
